description.INCIDENT_DETAIL_CN: 香港單車節（十月十一日（星期日））- 新界區及九龍區封路

2026-10-07T17:37:00.CONTENT_EN:
Hong Kong Cyclothon (11 Oct (Sun)) - Road Closures in New Territories and Kowloon

Special traffic and transport arrangements will be implemented in phases at various locations in the New Territories South, Kowloon West, West Kowloon Cultural District and the Central Kowloon Bypass (Yau Ma Tei Section) from 1am Sunday (11 October) to facilitate the holding of the 2026 Hong Kong Cyclothon.

Motorists should pay particular attention to the road closures and public transport arrangements at the Lantau Link, Ting Kau Bridge, Cheung Tsing Tunnel, Stonecutters Bridge, Eagle's Nest Tunnel, Sha Tin Heights Tunnel, West Kowloon Highway and Central Kowloon Bypass (Yau Ma Tei Section) on that day. Due to extensive road closures, the TD anticipates that traffic will be very congested. Motorists are advised to avoid driving to the affected/congested areas unless absolutely necessary and should exercise restraint and patience in case of traffic congestion and follow instructions by the Police.

During the event, the road closures will not affect vehicles from Hong Kong Island/Kowloon/the New Territories East heading for the airport and Lantau Island. Due to the closure of Ting Kau Bridge (Kowloon bound), motorists travelling from the New Territories West to the Airport and Lantau Island via Tuen Mun Road or Tai Lam Tunnel will be diverted to use Tsuen Wan Road, Tsuen Tsing Interchange, Tsing Tsuen Road, Tsing Tsuen Bridge, Tam Kong Shan Interchange and Tsing Yi North Coastal Road heading for Tsing Ma Bridge.

Both traffic bounds of Western Harbour Crossing will remain in normal operation. Due to the closure of the West Kowloon Highway (Western Harbour Crossing bound), motorists traveling from New Territories West or Kowloon West to Hong Kong Island will be diverted via the slip road of Lin Cheung Road (northbound) near the Civil Aid Service Headquarters heading for the Western Harbour Crossing.

For details of road closure on the event day, please refer to the Transport Department Notice:
(https://www.td.gov.hk/en/traffic_notices/index_id_89116.html).
2026-10-07T17:37:00.CONTENT_CN:
香港單車節（十月十一日（星期日））-新界區及九龍區封路

為配合舉行二○二六香港單車節，新界南、九龍西、西九文化區及中九龍繞道（油麻地段）多處在周日（十月十一日）凌晨一時起分階段實施特別交通及運輸安排。

駕駛人士請特別留意活動當日在青嶼幹線、汀九橋、長青隧道、昂船洲大橋、尖山隧道、沙田嶺隧道、西九龍公路及中九龍繞道（油麻地段）的封路安排。運輸署預計大範圍封路將會令交通非常擠塞，駕駛人士如非必要，請不要駕車前往受影響的地區。如遇交通受阻，駕車人士請保持忍讓，並遵從警方的指示。

封路安排將不會影響由港島／九龍／新界東前往機場及大嶼山的車輛。至於由新界西經屯門公路或大欖隧道前往機場及大嶼山的車輛，由於受到汀九橋（九龍方向）封閉的影響，需改經荃灣路、荃青交匯處、青荃路、青荃橋、担杆山交匯處及青衣北岸公路前往青馬大橋。

西區海底隧道（來回方向）亦將維持正常行車。至於由新界西或九龍西前往港島的車輛，受西九龍公路（往西區海底隧道方向）封閉影響，需改經連翔道（北行）近民眾安全服務隊總部的支路前往西區海底隧道。

有關活動當日封路的詳細資料，請參閱運輸署公告：
（https://www.td.gov.hk/tc/traffic_notices/index_id_89116.html）。

• vehicles from Kowloon West via Lin Cheung Road to Kowloon East will be diverted via Lai Cheung Road, Gascoigne Road flyover, Chatham Road North and East Kowloon Corridor heading for Kai Tak Tunnel.
